usedFor: GetResponse holds the email lists and contacts, LeadConnector receives them with “Create Or Update Contact”, starting from “New Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in GetResponse, then “Create Or Update Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: It updates the contact if it already exists in LeadConnector, instead of leaving a duplicate.

watchOut: “New Contact” in GetResponse is polling, so the contact reaches LeadConnector after a short delay.
